weekly_objective: Absorb the recent build block and Tuesday's committed double while holding strength and aerobic fitness, arriving fresh for next week.
coach_says: Missing Wednesday's swim is no problem. You rode easy instead, and your HRV (45 ms, balanced) and resting HR (51 bpm, stable) say you're recovering well, so the swim is simply dropped rather than squeezed in. The only change is trimming Saturday's ride from 120 to 100 minutes, because this recovery week is already running a little heavier than planned (load 471 by Wednesday). The rest stays as written: Friday maintenance gym at lunch and Sunday recovery yoga.

days.details:
45 min | Flush legs before the Tuesday double | Z1-2, RPE 2-3
10 min easy warm-up Z1
30 min steady low Z2, cadence 90-95 rpm, no efforts
5 min easy cool-down
Indoor because of 80% drizzle. If it is dry after work, an easy flat MTB spin at the same effort is fine.

days.session: Committed double: AM controlled hills + PM hard MTB group ride
days.details:
AM (before work), road: 60 min | Aerobic climbing, controlled | Z2, RPE 4, top of Z2 on climbs only
15 min easy warm-up
35 min rolling hills, seated, steady Z2. No surges and no Z4+ (anaerobic load is already over target)
10 min easy cool-down
PM (after work), MTB: ~90 min hard group ride (committed). Ride it as the week's one hard session; efforts are as the group dictates.
Fuelling: eat a carb-rich lunch, take 40-60 g carbs/hr and a bottle on the group ride, and have a recovery meal with protein within 1 hr. Wet trails (100% drizzle), so ride with care.
days.fallback: If HRV is below baseline or resting HR is 5+ bpm up: replace the AM hills with 30 min easy Z1 spin or skip it entirely. Still do the PM group ride but sit in, skip the sprints and let gaps go on climbs.

days.details:
Warmup: 200 m easy freestyle, mixing in backstroke
Main set: 6x100 m easy aerobic, RPE 3-4, 20 s rest; 2x50 m relaxed drill (catch-up), 20 s rest
Cooldown: 100 m very easy
Total: 1000 m
Objective: Promote recovery from Tuesday with low-impact movement and no hard efforts.

60 min | Aerobic maintenance | Z2, RPE 3-4
10 min easy warm-up
45 min steady Z2, cadence 85-95 rpm, conversational
5 min easy cool-down
Indoor because of drizzle and wind up to 29 km/h. Keep it truly easy and don't turn it into a big ride like last Thursday.

Workout A:
Warm-up: 5 min row or bike, leg swings, glute bridges 2x10, 2 ramp-up sets of squat
Back Squat 2x5 (same load as your last completed session, 2-3 RIR)
Romanian Deadlift 2x6 (2-3 RIR)
Pull-Up 2x6 (2 RIR)
Dumbbell Bench Press 2x8 (2 RIR)
Side Plank 2x30s/side
Dead Bug 2x8/side
Rest: 2-3 min between squat and RDL sets, 60-90 s for the rest
Objective: Keep strength in a recovery week with half the sets and the load held, avoiding fatigue.
days.fallback: If signals are poor: drop the squat and RDL and do pull-ups, bench and core only, or swap for 30 min mobility/yoga.

days.details:
100 min | Aerobic endurance, recovery-week volume | Z2, RPE 3-4
15 min easy warm-up
75 min steady Z2 on rolling roads. Take the climbs seated and stay in Z2, with no surges or town-sign sprints
10 min easy cool-down
Fuelling: 40-60 g carbs/hr from the start and 1 bottle/hr.
Shortened from 120 min because the week's load is already near the recovery-week target. Light drizzle (67%, 0.4 mm), wind up to 20 km/h. Still the least wet day, so ride outdoors with mudguards and a light jacket. If it is raining steadily, do 75 min steady Z2 indoors instead.
45 min gentle yoga focused on hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine and breathing. Light drizzle (78%, 1.6 mm) and warm (up to 29°C), so stay indoors. An easy walk is also fine.
